title: CUA Probe Contracts v1
description: Registry-consumable contracts for module probes and gap attribution subtypes. Two top-level definitions; registry should validate module instances against $defs.moduleProbeContract and ledger subtype rules against $defs.gapAttributionSubtype.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS schema document. Registry should refuse to load if it can't handle this major version.

contractVersion.description: Version of the contract data instances below. Registry compares this against its own minimum-supported contract version to gate hot-reloads.

moduleProbeContracts.description: Keyed by moduleId. Each value validates against $defs.moduleProbeContract.

gapAttributionSubtypes.description: Keyed by subtype id. Each value validates against $defs.gapAttributionSubtype.

signalId.description: Must be one of SUPPORTED_SIGNAL_IDS in cua-agent/playable_agent/signal_assertions.py. Registry validator should cross-check at contract-load time.

evidencePath.description: Dotted path. Runtime roots: phaseEvidence/entity_states/ui_state/camera_state/variables; runtime scalar 'phaseRealTimer'; ledger-attribution roots: spec/plan/cuaPlan/ledgerRecord/visual. Brackets allow [], <id> is a placeholder; '-' and '*' permitted inside placeholders (e.g. <before-after>, <*>).

clauseExpr.description: Atomic boolean clause. Eval engine evaluates against the runtime observation tuple (before_obs, after_obs, phaseEvidence, step).

ruleExpr.description: Composable rule node. Leaves are clauseExpr; internal nodes combine.

source.description: Where the check value was derived from, e.g. file path, registry key, ledger query. Required so module_completeness is never hand-edited.

blocking.description: If true, status!=present forces moduleCompleteness=0 for this module.

completenessChecks.description: Five pillars Jonny defined. Registry derives module_completeness = AND(check.status=='present' for blocking checks) / total. Never hand-fill.

failureAttributionEntry.description: Explicit priority drives ordering. Lower priority numbers evaluate first. Tie-break by id.

priority.description: Lower = evaluated first. Use sparse increments (10, 20, 30) so future entries can slot in without renumbering.

id.description: Stable identifier for this attribution rule. Useful for logs and tests.

expectedSignals.description: Signals the emitter MUST call RecordPhaseEvidenceFlag for, in any phase that activates this module.

recordPath.description: Where in pipeline metrics record this value should land, dotted.

source.description: Dotted path inside the runtime observation to copy from.

priority.description: Lower priority detectors evaluate first within the same parentGapType. Use sparse increments (10/20/30).

matchInputs.description: Inputs the detector reads. Used by registry to declare data dependencies.

metadataFields.description: Keys the detector must write into ledger entry.metadata for downstream querying.
